latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Object-Relational Structural Mapping Guide skill.

- Provides guidance on mapping domain model relationships to relational database schemas using six key PEAA structural patterns.
- Helps classify relationships (identity, 1:1, 1:N, N:M, dependent, embedded, graph) and routes each to the appropriate mapping pattern.
- Generates schema sketches and idiomatic ORM configuration for popular frameworks (Hibernate, SQLAlchemy, EF Core, ActiveRecord, Django ORM).
- Flags common anti-patterns, such as meaningful keys, misuse of serialized LOBs, and improper many-to-many mappings.
- Designed for architects and engineers designing new persistence layers or auditing existing ORM setups.
